messages:
jamie: FYI pushed change that flips default kernel preference to latency-first for many model profiles. No API/schema changes but users might see lower p95 and different tail characteristics. Deploy planned in the change window tomorrow. Do we treat as patch or minor?
ana: What's the risk surface? Any behavior that could break inference results/outputs?
jamie: No change to logits or tokenization, purely runtime selection. Observable: perf and slightly different scheduling timings.
ren: Semver debate: default behavior change that affects user-observed metrics is usually a minor (2.x -> 2.x+1). But we also try to avoid churn for ops.
ops-liaison: Ops request: can we gate this behind a runtime flag so customers can opt back to legacy without pinning versions? If yes that leans toward minor and safer rollout.
jamie: Yeah can add flag: REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEFAULT=legacy|latency_pref. Also we can expose a per-deployment override in Dedicated.
nana: If we add opt-out + canary and clear release-note, I'm fine with a minor bump. Otherwise patch with a very prominent note.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-23T06:00:00Z -> 5% traffic. Full rollout window: 2026-03-23 06:00-10:00Z. Auto-rollback if p95 > baseline by 20% for 5m.
ren: Suggest tagging plan: current is 2.14.7. If minor: tag 2.15.0 for the change and leave 2.14.8 open for hotfixes; if patch: 2.14.8.
ops-liaison: Also request a console banner for the first 48 hours pointing to the opt-out flag and guidance for latency-sensitive customers.
jamie: Agreed. I'll open a tiny PR to introduce the env var + config path, plus docs. Will also add telemetry metric kernel_choice and kernel_fallback_count to monitor.
nana: Nice. For release notes copy: "Default kernel selection updated to prefer latency-optimized kernels. This improves end-to-end latency for longer contexts; customers with strict latency contracts can set REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEFAULT=legacy while validating."
ren: Call: minor bump to 2.15.0, canary first, runtime opt-out, banner + release notes.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started. Monitoring hooks: p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, error_rate, kernel_fallback_count.
ops-liaison: I'll watch dashboards and notify infra if auto-rollback hits.
jamie: Thanks. After canary stable we'll tag 2.15.0 and merge release notes. :thumbsup:
